firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
I used to think that if your score matches a public notebook, you can make your own notebook public too. Then you could sort the public notebooks by score to see which one actually ranks higher.

But now something seems off. My submission with modified weights clearly ranks higher on the leaderboard than a submission using the original public notebook without any changes. However, my published notebook actually ranks lower in the public notebook rankings.

So I'm wondering: is it because public notebooks with the same displayed score aren't necessarily ranked by their actual underlying scores, or could this be caused by floating-point variations in GPU computations?
